concerns.text: FR-005 adds a sensitivity analysis of the suitability probability threshold (sweeping {0.40,0.45,0.50,0.55,0.60}) and a Benjamini‑Hochberg multiple‑comparison correction. The original idea never required a threshold‑sensitivity sweep or any multiple‑testing correction, so this is scope over‑reach.

FR-006 introduces a hard <100 occurrence‑record filter for the 2005‑2020 test period and flags such species as 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA'. The idea only calls for evaluating against recent records; it does not prescribe a minimum‑record threshold, making this an unnecessary addition.

FR-010 mandates hierarchical bootstrap resampling with ≥ 1000 iterations to compare model performance. The idea’s methodology sketch mentions paired statistical tests but never specifies a hierarchical bootstrap, so this requirement exceeds the original scope.

FR-011 requires a power analysis to validate the ≥100‑record rule (effect size = 0.50, power ≥ 0.8). The idea does not call for any a‑priori power analysis; this is an added methodological step not requested by the research question.
FR-015 repeats the power‑analysis documentation requirement introduced in FR-011, further expanding scope beyond what the idea demanded.

SC-002 imposes a hard compute‑time budget of 360 minutes on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner. The original idea contains no compute‑time constraints; this engineering limit is outside the scientific scope.
SC-003 requires reporting false‑positive/false‑negative rates for the threshold sweep introduced in FR-005. Since FR-005 itself is out‑of‑scope, this success criterion also over‑reaches.

SC-004 demands ≥ 95 % of species to retain ≥ 100 records after thinning and ≥ 99 % non‑null climate values. The idea never specified such completeness metrics, so this success criterion adds unnecessary scope.

FR-008 forces all reports to include an associational disclaimer. The idea’s research question already frames findings as observational; mandating a specific disclaimer string is an extra deliverable not required by the original idea.
FR-005 also requires Benjamini‑Hochberg correction for the paired hypothesis tests, a statistical adjustment not mentioned in the idea and therefore an unnecessary scope expansion.
